attchmntText: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication related to Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for Quarter ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on 13th November, 2026, in the Indian Express Delhi and Mumbai editions, the Financial Express Chennai edition, and the Jansatta Delhi edition. The information is also available on the company website at www.itdc.co.in. In separate legal proceedings, the National Company Law Tribunal in New Delhi directed Techbeliever Technologies Private Limited to serve notice on Hybrid Adtech Private Limited via newspaper publication. The matter is scheduled for hearing on 16th November, 2026.

attchmntText: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: India Tourism Development Corporation submitted un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 2,882.31 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 19,547.08 lakhs. Earnings per share were 3.36. The independent auditor issued an unmodified review conclusion. The report highlights several matters requiring attention. Certain trade receivables and payables balances are pending confirmation and reconciliation. An amount of 1,882.09 lakhs is recoverable from the Delhi Development Authority and remains unresolved. A property tax dispute with the New Delhi Municipal Council is subject to resolution. Prior period adjustments were made for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company lacked the requisite number of independent directors during the reporting period.
